assertion_results.text: Step 1 extracts imprecise affected range from the Jira description — the description lacks a specific version threshold (Step 1 Data Extraction)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md line 12: 'Affected version range | versions prior to the fix (imprecise -- no exact threshold in Jira description)'. Line 13: 'Fixed version | see advisory (not specified precisely in Jira description)'. Lines 41-43 explicitly note: 'The Jira description provides only an imprecise affected range ("versions prior to the fix") and no concrete fixed version ("see advisory"). External CVE data enrichment (Step 1.5) is required to determine the precise fix threshold for version impact analysis.'

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 queries MITRE CVE API and extracts lessThan 0.4.8 as the fix threshold from the affected[].versions[] field (§1.62)
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md lines 7-13: Source URL 'https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-48901', parsed data shows 'Affected range: versions less than 0.4.8 (semver)' and 'Fix threshold: 0.4.8 (from lessThan field)'.

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 queries OSV.dev API and extracts fixed version 0.4.8 from the affected[].ranges[].events field (§1.62)
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md lines 17-24: Source URL 'https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/CVE-2026-48901', parsed data shows 'Introduced: 0 (all versions from the beginning)' and 'Fixed: 0.4.8'.

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 cross-validation shows agreement between MITRE and OSV.dev — the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) is used as the authoritative value for Step 2.3
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md lines 35-36: 'Agreement: MITRE CVE API and OSV.dev both report the fix threshold as 0.4.8.' Cross-Validation Table (lines 28-33) shows both sources reporting 0.4.8. Line 44: 'Authoritative fix threshold: h2 >= 0.4.8'. Line 46: 'This enriched threshold is used for Step 2 version impact comparisons.'

assertion_results.text: Step 2.3 version impact comparison uses the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) from Step 1.5, not the imprecise Jira description data
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md lines 4-5: 'From Step 1.5 cross-validation: h2 < 0.4.8 is affected (MITRE and OSV.dev agree).' Line 7: table header 'CVE-2026-48901 (h2 < 0.4.8)'. Version comparisons explicitly use 0.4.8 as threshold: '0.4.5 < 0.4.8' (line 13), '0.4.8 >= 0.4.8 (fix version)' (line 14). The enriched threshold from Step 1.5 is used throughout, not the imprecise Jira description.
